evidence.quote: 1ère et 3ème années à Séville (cours en espagnol) au sein de la Facultad de Ciencias Económicas y Empresariales, 2ème et 4ème années à Colmar (cours en français et anglais) au sein de l'UHA Business School

notes: Applicant has a Moroccan Baccalauréat (foreign diploma): no applicationChannel is given, per instruction (route is Études en France / Campus France). teachingLanguages: Spanish and English are taught only in specific years of this dual-campus programme (years 1 and 3 in Spanish at Seville, years 2 and 4 in French and English at Colmar); the full programme is therefore not taught in a single language, so fr, es and en are all listed. tuition: the programme page states 178 EUR per year, a general figure; no separate non-EU rate is stated on the page. The Campus France page states differentiated tuition of 2 902 EUR for a Licence year for non-EU students ('2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence'), but that is an institution-wide/general figure, not stated for this programme, so it was excluded; a non-EU applicant should verify with the institution (exoneration possible per that page). documents: 'projet de formation' is quoted too, but it is a Parcoursup field name, not a listed document, so it is omitted. intakes: omitted because no dated application deadline with day, month and year is given on the page for this programme (the oral interview window 15 April–4 May 2026 and the Parcoursup response date are not application deadlines).
